name: Disneyland Pooh Corner "Tigger Tail" Caramel Marshmallow Wand (Check Orange Coating)
whyItWorks: Giant marshmallows dipped in caramel and orange-tinted white chocolate; while low in fiber, the orange-colored coating sometimes uses natural orange citrus oil/flavoring—so choose the plain Chocolate Caramel Marshmallow Wand instead if strictly avoiding trace citrus!
prepOrOrderInstructions: If sensitive to trace orange flavoring, choose the classic **Milk/Dark Chocolate Caramel Marshmallow Wand** right next to the Tigger Tails in the Pooh Corner case.
watchOuts: Orange candy coating may contain natural orange oil/flavoring (citrusFree: false)—opt for the chocolate caramel wand to be 100% citrus-safe
